Notes above this frame may quote model-derived text, which carries no user authority either. The report follows:
  [critical] /tmp/agentos-D-mGhIs5/src/text.js:15 - The commit changed the thousands-separator regex from `(\d{3})+` to `(\d{2})+`, so `formatRupiah` now groups digits in pairs - `formatRupiah(1500000)` returns `"Rp 1.50.00.00"` instead of `"Rp 1.500.000"`, and `formatRupiah(12345)` returns `"Rp 1.23.45"`. Every Rupiah amount shown in the sample profile page would be wrong, and the commit breaks the existing test - Finance or Marketing reading a displayed price would see a wrong figure. Fix: revert the quantifier to `\d{3}`, i.e. `/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g`.
  
  Checked:
  - `git show --stat HEAD` and `git diff HEAD~1`: the commit touches only `src/text.js`, a one-line regex change.

  - Ran `npm test`: 1 of 2 tests fails. `test/text.test.js:11` expects `"Rp 1.500.000"` and gets `"Rp 1.50.00.00"`. `slugify` tests pass.
